environment.description: Service runs on ECS Fargate tasks in private subnet (no IGW route, no NAT for inbound). Traffic ingresses exclusively through an internal NLB (network load balancer) with a target group health check on /healthz. The NLB listener on port 443 has TLS termination with a private CA cert. Upstream connectivity is provided by a VPC PrivateLink endpoint (vpce-0f8a3b21c7e) exposed only to a specific consumer VPC (vpc-0d4e91a7f2). The consumer VPC's route table (rtb-0c7a2e5f19) has no internet gateway or NAT gateway attached — it connects only to the corporate WAN via a Transit Gateway (tgw-0b3f8a1c6d) with a static route table that propagates only RFC1918 prefixes from three known CIDR blocks: 10.128.0.0/16 (corporate office), 172.20.0.0/14 (VPN concentrator pool), and 192.168.64.0/18 (partner DMZ). The Transit Gateway route table (tgw-rtb-0e5a9c2f7b) has no 0.0.0.0/0 route and blackhole routes for all other prefixes. Additionally, the PrivateLink endpoint policy restricts the principal to arn:aws:iam::447291034512:role/chat-consumer-role, meaning only workloads assuming that specific IAM role in the consumer account can resolve and connect to the endpoint DNS.

config.compute: ECS Fargate in private subnet (no public IP, no IGW)
config.ingress: Internal NLB with TLS (private CA) -> PrivateLink endpoint vpce-0f8a3b21c7e
config.consumer_vpc_routing: No IGW, no NAT, Transit Gateway only with static RFC1918 propagation
config.transit_gateway_route_table: tgw-rtb-0e5a9c2f7b: propagates only 10.128.0.0/16, 172.20.0.0/14, 192.168.64.0/18; blackhole for all other prefixes; no default route
config.tls: mTLS with private CA - clients must present cert signed by internal CA
